page_title: Teapot Router — One gateway for enterprise AI

sources.entry: Teapot Router - Team API gateway for GPT and Claude Code: one shared token pool, per-request metering (model, tokens, cache hits, exact cost), a public price book with no login, and org-level key management. #paid

summary.name: Teapot Router
summary.one_liner: Teapot Router is a prepaid, pay-as-you-go gateway (relay) that gives teams one endpoint for Claude Code and OpenAI GPT models, with per-request cost records and automatic failover between upstream channels.
keywords: pay as you go ai api
use_cases: Route Claude Code sessions through one team endpoint
Share a prepaid API balance across an engineering team
Track per-request token use and cost for reconciliation
Fail over to another upstream channel when a model route errors
Compare Claude and GPT model prices before choosing a model
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a gateway that sends Claude Code (Sonnet, Opus, Haiku) and OpenAI GPT requests (Responses and Chat Completions) to configured upstream model channels. Teams switch by setting ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL or the OpenAI base_url and using a Teapot Router API key. It can retry an eligible route when one channel fails, and it records model, tokens, cache use, duration and charges per request. A public price table lists base rates and Teapot Router prices per million tokens, with a stated 35% of standard rate for listed models. The page says it is not a model provider itself.
notable: Single endpoint for Claude Code and OpenAI GPT with a public price book that needs no login
Per-request ledger with model, tokens, cost and timestamp for finance reconciliation
Configurable upstream channels with retry on eligible route failure and route priority/weight tuning
Demo workspace available without sign-up, with a preloaded sample run in the Model Lab
caveats: Paid usage is prepaid balance based; API usage is charged against account balance, and final charges may differ from the table due to group rates and caching
Available models and behavior depend on the configured upstream channels; it covers only Claude Code and GPT
Refund policy: remaining paid balance is refundable on request, but gifted or promotional credit is not
